notes: §2002:14.8.44.3 GR9: a zero-length delimiter identifier is ignored. The golden's DELIMITED BY L OR ";" with L a zero-length ANY LENGTH formal (the BY CONTENT group at N=0) is delimited by the ";" alone (AB, CD, P=06 T=2), and the same statement with L three or five characters long finds no delimiter in the sending item but the ";". kb/Work PB5621.
